evidence.reason: Tracked every harness tool dispatch (both the SDK tool() handlers and the native tools/call adapter) in a per-run in-flight set and awaited their settlements right after the query settles and before denial mapping, observation persistence and the verdict, so a handler that appends a tool message or pushes a denial after the query fails still reaches the caller; no local tests were run because the harness exposes no test command.
